text_sanskrit: यद्यद्विभूतिमत्सत्त्वं श्रीमदूर्जितमेव वा । तत्तदेवावगच्छ त्वं मम तेजोंऽशसम्भवम् ॥ १०-४१ ॥
itrans: yadyadvibhUtimatsattvaM shrImadUrjitameva vA . tattadevAvagachCha tvaM mama tejo.n.ashasambhavam .. 10-41 ..
translation: Whatever existence or being is excellent of its kind, splendid, of deep-rooted life, understand that to have come into existence with a spark of Mine.
